mapper.sql: e.id, e.emp_no, e.name, e.name_en, e.birth_date, e.gender, e.id_card, e.mobile, e.email, e.department_id, d.name as department_name, e.position_id, p.name as position_name, e.grade_id, e.employment_type, e.employment_status, e.entry_date, e.probation_end_date, e.regularization_date, e.leave_date, e.leave_reason, e.login_account_flag, e.education, e.nation, e.health_status, e.height, e.weight, e.marital_status, e.work_years, e.birthplace, e.address, e.emergency_contact, e.emergency_phone, e.specialty, e.avatar, e.remark, e.delflag, e.tenant_id, e.created_at, e.updated_at, e.created_by, e.updated_by

e.id, e.emp_no, e.name, e.name_en, e.gender, e.birth_date, e.id_card, e.mobile, e.email, e.avatar, e.department_id, d.name as department_name, e.position_id, p.name as position_name, e.secondary_position_ids, e.grade_id, e.employment_type, e.employment_status, e.entry_date, e.probation_end_date, e.regularization_date, e.leave_date, e.leave_reason, e.work_years, e.education, e.graduation_school, e.major, e.marital_status, e.address, e.emergency_contact, e.emergency_phone, e.created_at, e.updated_at, e.created_by, eg.grade_name, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS age, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, e.entry_date, CURDATE()) AS work_days, creator.name AS creator_name
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON e.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN workposition p ON e.position_id = p.id WHERE e.id = #{id}

SELECT
FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON e.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN workposition p ON e.position_id = p.id WHERE e.emp_no = #{empNo}

SELECT
FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON e.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN workposition p ON e.position_id = p.id WHERE e.mobile = #{mobile}

SELECT
FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON e.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN workposition p ON e.position_id = p.id WHERE e.id_card = #{idCard}

SELECT
FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON e.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN workposition p ON e.position_id = p.id WHERE e.department_id = #{departmentId} ORDER BY e.entry_date DESC

SELECT
FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON e.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN workposition p ON e.position_id = p.id WHERE e.position_id = #{positionId} ORDER BY e.entry_date DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM employee WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} AND employment_status = 1 AND delflag = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM employee WHERE (position_id = #{positionId} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{positionId}, secondary_position_ids) > 0) AND employment_status = 1 AND delflag = 0

SELECT
FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON e.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN workposition p ON e.position_id = p.id LEFT JOIN employee_grade eg ON e.grade_id = eg.id LEFT JOIN employee creator ON e.created_by = creator.id WHERE e.delflag = 0 AND e.employment_status = 2 AND e.probation_end_date IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(e.probation_end_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 0 AND #{days} ORDER BY e.probation_end_date ASC

SELECT
FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON e.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN workposition p ON e.position_id = p.id LEFT JOIN employee_grade eg ON e.grade_id = eg.id LEFT JOIN employee creator ON e.created_by = creator.id WHERE e.delflag = 0 AND e.employment_status = 1 AND e.birth_date IS NOT NULL
AND MONTH(e.birth_date) = #{month}
ORDER BY DAY(e.birth_date) ASC

SELECT CONCAT(#{prefix}, #{year}, LPAD(IFNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(emp_no, LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 5) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1, 4, '0')) FROM employee WHERE emp_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, #{year}, '%') AND delflag = 0

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN employment_status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS activeCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN employment_status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS probationCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN employment_status = 3 THEN 1 END) AS leaveCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(entry_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') THEN 1 END) AS thisMonthJoinCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(leave_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') AND employment_status = 3 THEN 1 END) AS thisMonthLeaveCount FROM employee WHERE delflag = 0

SELECT e.department_id AS departmentId, e.department_name AS departmentName, COUNT(1) AS employeeCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN e.employment_status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS activeCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN e.employment_status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS probationCount FROM employee e WHERE e.delflag = 0 GROUP BY e.department_id, e.department_name ORDER BY employeeCount DESC
